europe_now.title: EU Hybrid Attack Contingency Planning
europe_now.summary: The European Union is quietly bracing for potential multiple-casualty hybrid attacks. Officials are assessing regional security vulnerabilities and response measures.

europe_now.title: German Former Spy Chief Arrested
europe_now.summary: A former German spy chief has been detained over suspected treasonous espionage. Authorities have taken the former official into custody as investigations continue.

top_stories.title: French School Protests and Unrest
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of students, unions, and teachers have joined demonstrations across France to demand better learning conditions. Riot police clashed with protesters and deployed tear gas during the widespread unrest.

top_stories.title: European Union Expansion and Safeguards
top_stories.summary: The European Commission is seeking 15-year safeguards on future member states as part of its expansion policy. Officials maintain that these reforms will not create a two-tier European Union.
